spec.name: ac-dc-meshed Monte Carlo storm-stress base (10 snapshots)
spec.description: Base scenario for a StormRisk Monte Carlo study: the full 10-hour ac-dc-meshed horizon with load shedding at VOLL. Outages and demand are sampled by StormRisk from the modelled distributions in 'sampling'.
assumptions: ac-dc-meshed is the PyPSA example network (synthetic, illustrative); it does not represent the real UK/German/Norwegian system.

outage_classes.name: ac-lines-storm
outage_classes.source: MODELLED author-selected whole-horizon stress probability, not observed or calibrated. Context only: IEEE RTS-96 Table 12 (Grigg et al., The IEEE Reliability Test System-1996, IEEE Trans. Power Syst. 14(3):1010-1020, 1999; https://labs.ece.uw.edu/pstca/rts/rts96/Table-12.txt) lists branch outage rates 0.24-0.54 /yr and typical durations 10-16 h (some 35 h), giving stationary unavailability of order 1e-4 to 1e-3 via lambda*r/8760. q=0.05 is deliberately larger, an illustrative assumption, not a weather multiplier inferred from RTS-96.

outage_classes.name: dc-lines-storm
outage_classes.source: MODELLED author-selected stress probability, not observed or calibrated: q=0.05, the same illustrative assumption as ac-lines-storm. IEEE RTS-96 Table 12 provides stationary branch-reliability context only, not DC-specific or weather-conditioned failure statistics.

outage_classes.name: hvdc-links-converters
outage_classes.source: MODELLED assumption, not observed data: illustrative forced unavailability for HVDC converters/links of order 1e-2 (same order as the smaller thermal-unit forced outage rates in IEEE RTS-96, Grigg et al. 1999, Table 6). No HVDC-specific statistics are used.

outage_classes.name: gas-units
outage_classes.source: MODELLED assumption, not observed data: forced outage rate of a mid-size thermal unit from IEEE RTS-96 generator reliability data (Grigg et al. 1999, Table 6, https://labs.ece.uw.edu/pstca/rts/rts96/Table-06.txt: thermal-unit FOR 0.02-0.12; 197 MW oil/steam = 0.05). Each ac-dc-meshed gas generator is an aggregated plant, so a whole-plant FOR is a strong simplification.

outage_classes.name: wind-farms
outage_classes.source: MODELLED assumption, not observed data: whole-farm unavailability (e.g. export cable/substation fault) set to 0.02, of the order of the smaller IEEE RTS-96 unit FORs (Grigg et al. 1999, Table 6). Weather-driven wind variability is already in the network's p_max_pu series.

demand_multiplier.source: MODELLED assumption, not observed data: +/-10 % demand uncertainty around the dataset's load series (illustrative three-point distribution).

probability_model.description: independent whole-horizon component unavailabilities (sampling_spec.outage_classes) and optional demand-multiplier distribution

assumptions: Component unavailabilities are MODELLED inputs (see sampling_spec.outage_classes[].source); they are not observed failure statistics of the studied network.
Components fail independently of each other and of demand; class probabilities do not represent common-mode or weather-correlated failures.
Every sampled outage lasts the whole study horizon (the PyPSA adapter supports topology changes for the whole horizon only); no repair or restoration within the horizon.
Each sampled state is solved as a DC linearised optimal power flow (PyPSA LOPF, HiGHS) with load shedding at VOLL; no AC feasibility, voltage, stability or protection behaviour.
Crude (unstratified) Monte Carlo; uncertainty is sampling error only (CLT normal approximation). Model/parameter uncertainty is not included in the confidence interval.
ac-dc-meshed is the PyPSA example network (synthetic, illustrative); it does not represent the real UK/German/Norwegian system.
limitations: Not a reliability assessment of any real power system: the probabilities are generic modelled values and the network models are research/example datasets.
EENS here is the expected unserved energy over the study horizon conditional on the base scenario (e.g. its snapshots and demand), not an annual adequacy index.
Importance ranking is descriptive co-occurrence, not causal attribution.
payload.study_title: ac-dc-meshed: Monte Carlo storm-stress EENS (modelled outage probabilities, 10 h)
